         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha 1</rs> byang chub sems dpa'i sdoM pa'i rten du so sor thar ba dgos pa yin te ¦ phan 'dogs pa la gnod pa spong bas khyab pa'i phyir dang ¦ <expan>so sor</expan> thar pa rigs bdun gyi <choice><reg>||</reg><orig>‹||›</orig></choice> <quote><lg><l>rtag du sdoM pa ldan pa la ||</l> <l>skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min ||</l></lg></quote> zhes gsungs pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan> zhes <expan>zer ro</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
